fundamentals.name: Arm Holdings plc
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Arm Holdings plc researches, develops, licenses, and markets central processing unit (CPU) intellectual property (IP), graphics processing unit IP, systems IP, compute subsystems (CSS), and associated software, tools and related services. The company provides a product portfolio, including CPU IP, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU) accelerators, system IP such as interconnects, compute platform products including pre-integrated CSSs, and development tools and software. The company serves semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cloud service providers (CSPs), and organizations developing chips for end markets such as smartphones, consumer electronics, industrial IoT, embedded systems, cloud data centers, networking, automotive, and robotics. It provides its products and services in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Arm Holdings plc operates as a subsidiary of SoftBank Group Corp.

judgment.summary: Extremely high valuation multiples and significant insider selling overshadow strong reported growth and margins.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter EPS was $0.60 vs estimate $0.58; next earnings date is 2026-07-29.
positives: Revenue growth 20.1% YoY and earnings growth 47.9% YoY indicate strong top-line and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin at 97.5% and operating margin at 29.5% demonstrate exceptional operational efficiency.
Strong liquidity with a current ratio of 6.00 and quick ratio of 5.83.
Free cash flow of $750.50M TTM provides solid operational cash generation.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 405.75 and Forward P/E of 114.00 suggest extreme overvaluation.
Price/Sales (TTM) of 75.75 and Price/Book of 44.81 are exceptionally high.
Debt/Equity ratio of 5.93 indicates significant leverage.
Insider selling of $25.6 million suggests a lack of confidence from management.
Mean analyst target of $247.41 is substantially below the current trading price.

news.paragraph: ARM is facing significant headwinds, with recent analysis suggesting its intrinsic value is far below its current market price, and a DCF analysis placing it at $18 versus its trading price of $343. This comes amidst a broader tech selloff, where ARM has been a leading decliner, contributing to a more than 4% drop in the Nasdaq-100. Furthermore, insider selling totaling $25.6 million occurred just before a historic rally, raising questions about valuation and market timing.
